title: Temple Theme Kit inner pages, group A: Ceremonies and hire, About and Contact as TempleKitInner blocks
detail: Seven block types (TempleKitInnerHero, Story, Team, Stats, Service, Faq, Contact), one scoped sheet (components/sites/temple-kit-inner/inner-css.ts, tokens only, tki-* classes) and three page builders (components/sites/temple-kit-inner/pages.ts) for the design's About, Ceremonies and hire and Contact pages. The contact form goes through the anonymous lead door. Owner facts are {{slot|sample}} tokens. Registration (block map into lib/page-editor/config.tsx, the sheet into the skin, the pages into the kit) belongs to the Temple kit registration pass; this row ships the parts it wires in. Groups B to D (Book, Membership and Gatherings, Programs, Shop and Library) follow under LIVE-1685 to 1689.

verify.evidence: temple-kit-inner.tsx exports the TempleKitInner block map.
verify.cmd: node -e 'const t=require("fs").readFileSync("components/page-editor/blocks/temple-kit-inner.tsx","utf8");for(const b of ["Hero","Story","Team","Stats","Service","Faq","Contact"])if(!t.includes("TempleKitInner"+b+":")){console.error("a Temple Kit inner block is missing: "+b);process.exit(1)}'
